description: The proxy's local dashboard and mode-control step in holon-coherence intercepts /holon/* and /_holon/* paths without validating the request Host header, sets a wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin header on metrics responses, exposes unauthenticated POST /holon/api/mode that accepts arbitrary wire_log_dir paths, and ignores runtime mode overrides in GET /holon/api/mode when HOLON_PASSIVE_MONITORING=1.
goal: Harden src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/serve_dashboard.py (keeping it at most 200 lines, with zero docstrings and zero comments so tests/proxy/test_proxy_self_doc.py passes) and add unit tests in tests/proxy/test_steps.py (also zero docstrings and zero comments): restrict /holon, /holon/*, and /_holon/* interception to explicit loopback hosts (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1, [::1]) checked from the request Host header (falling back to the parsed request URL host) so external-Host requests return Outcome.CONTINUE untouched; remove Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * from serve_metrics (never emit wildcard CORS); require constant-time (hmac.compare_digest) Bearer token authentication on POST /holon/api/mode and POST /_holon/mode against HOLON_COHERENCE_API_TOKEN or HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB_PASSWORD (failing closed with 401 when unset, missing, or invalid), and reject non-loopback Origin headers on POST with 403; confine wire_log_dir on mode POST inside the configured allowed base directory (HOLON_WIRE_LOG_BASE_DIR or the addon's initial base wire_log_dir) via Path.resolve().is_relative_to(...), returning 400 on traversal or out-of-bounds paths; and fix _mode_get so an explicit runtime boolean addon.default_passive takes precedence over is_passive_monitoring() even when HOLON_PASSIVE_MONITORING=1 is set. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Host-less local endpoint interception combined with wildcard CORS and an unauthenticated mode/path mutator lets any upstream request or cross-origin page alter proxy state and redirect wire logs to arbitrary filesystem paths.
acceptance_criteria: Requests for /holon/* targeting external Host headers pass through upstream untouched.
Unauthenticated or cross-origin POST /holon/api/mode requests return 401/403, and path traversal / out-of-bounds wire_log_dir values return 400.
GET /holon/api/mode returns the effective runtime mode even when HOLON_PASSIVE_MONITORING=1.
